title: Malaysian Satay with Roasted Vegetables
description: A flavorful and colorful dish that combines the rich flavors of Malaysia with the earthy sweetness of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Toss the mixed vegetables in coconut oil, coriander, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
In a blender, combine peanut sauce, ginger, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Thread the roasted vegetables onto skewers and brush with peanut sauce.
Grill the satay for 2-3 minutes per side or until slightly charred.
Serve the satay with additional peanut sauce and roasted peanuts.
